title: τ(M∩V,θ,ξ) for V ⊂⊂ U is an integer multiplicity current on ℝ^P of finite mass
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, V, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ and θ(x) ∈ ℕ for all x ∈ M. Suppose V ⊂⊂ U, i.e. V is open, closure V is compact and closure V ⊆ U. Then there is an integer multiplicity current X ∈ D_n(ℝ^P) with M(X) < ∞ and X(ω) = ∫_{M∩V} θ⟨ω,ξ⟩ dHⁿ = tauAction n (M ∩ V) θ ξ ω for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ k : ℕ, θ x = k) → CompactlyContainedOpen V U → ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity X ∧ X.mass < ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, X ω = tauAction n (M ∩ V) θ ξ ω
